# Entropy_Connectivity_Path

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A measure of information-theoretic entropy used to identify and characterize the strength or existence of connectivity paths in neural networks. Provides a quantitative, topology-aware metric for assessing communication pathways in brain-inspired or neuromorphic interconnect fabrics.
